input.quote: 12.1 Term. The term of this Agreement shall commence upon the Effective Date and, unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Article XII, shall continue in full force and effect until the expiration of Sanofi's payment obligations under Article IX or the Profit/Loss Share Agreement, whichever is later (the "Term").
input.rationale: This is a collaboration/licence agreement with no renewal mechanic at all. Section 12.1 sets a single Term that runs to the expiration of Sanofi's payment obligations under Article IX or the Profit/Loss Share Agreement (which are in turn bounded by the Royalty Term in Section 9.3(b)), subject only to early termination under Article XII. Targeted searches for "renew", "automatically renew", "successive/additional term", "unless either Party gives written notice prior to expiration", and price-uplift/CPI language returned no auto-renewal, no non-renewal notice window, and no renewal price-increase mechanic (the only "renewal" hits are patent continuations and insurance non-renewal notice, neither of which is a term renewal). Because there is no automatic renewal, the conditional preferred and fallback elements (renewal term length, opt-out window, Vendor reminder, and price-increase caps) are not triggered, and any extension of the Term would require the Parties' mutual agreement. The clause therefore creates no lock-in or notice-window trap for us, and there is nothing to redline; the rule is structurally inapplicable to this deal.
